newsitem.title: CHILE: Placer, TVX Gold study Chile mine.
newsitem.headline: Placer, TVX Gold study Chile mine.

text.p: Canadian mining companies Placer Dome and TVX Gold are planning to invest $30 million in developing the Chimberos silver deposit in the northern Atacama Desert, said Placer spokesman Felipe Ruiz.
"We are in the process of carrying out a feasibility study on the project," Ruiz told Reuters.
The deposit, which lies 40 km from Placer's La Coipa gold/silver mine, holds 30 million ounces of silver, he said.
The mine will be operated by a company known as Minera Mantos de Oro which is owned equally by Placer and TVX Gold.
Minera Mantos de Oro has submitted an environmental impact study for the project and expects to begin building work early next year.
La Coipa producer 282,000 ounces of gold last year and nine million ounces of silver.
